price_basis: author scenario net revenue and reference costs; not RW contracts
tax_basis: author ex recoverable VAT; actual tax cash and recoverability UNKNOWN
market_unit: scenario one-way endpoint journeys; fractional volumes are model allocations, not booked persons

episode.selection: origin departure or destination arrival at restricted airport in [start,end)
episode.duration_basis: explicit 24-hour stress input; no observed episode or publication count used

other_risks.note: No new numerical estimate for these risks. Existing deicing assumptions and base/cautious parameters are preserved. No claim the author model fully prices all of them.

fuel_and_unstarted_pax_only.meaning: Cancellation before journey starts: unburned fuel retained in stock and unprovided passenger service. Other contracted charges retained pending terms. Fractions are conditional inputs, not observations.

usage_billed_mro_uplift_navigation.meaning: Additional sensitivity ONLY IF uplift, MRO reserves and navigation are billed solely for the cancelled operation. No empirical avoidability established. Crew and airport commitments remain.

scenarios.protection: none; full affected endpoint journey unserved; refund net fare once; old RW migration unchanged
same unserved journeys; alternative contract billing condition only
conditional whole bank next day; same passengers and fare; slots/crew/MCT/hotels UNKNOWN; no automatic operational acceptance

scenarios.note: Counterfactual with no kover only; no prediction of removal date; all other risks and author costs preserved

cash_timing_stress.scope: incremental difference from identical author no-kover tickets; illustrative net-of-tax timing, not bank cash or financing quote
cash_timing_stress.fuel_cash_mechanism: Fuel already bought: cancellation preserves inventory; cash appears only if replenishment is reduced later
cash_timing_stress.other_avoidable_cash_mechanism: Avoidable usage/passenger charges would settle at day3; no claim about actual contracts

actual_reaccommodation: UNKNOWN; MCT/protected ticket terms/available alternative inventory not established
tail_assignment: author aircraft labels are planning resource identifiers, not actual tail registrations; no unobserved cascade inferred
full_budget: UNKNOWN; numerical contribution and cash stress exclude explicitly registered additional terms
